characters.name: MARI
characters.description: Väike inimene, tüdruk, heledad lühikesed juuksed, kannab kollast kleiti ja roosasid kingi. Rõõmsameelne ja uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: JUKU
characters.description: Väike inimene, poiss, pruunid lühikesed juuksed, kannab sinist t-särki ja rohelisi pükse. Sõbralik ja abivalmis näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Mängunurk
locations.description: Cozy children's play corner inside a room with light blue walls, a soft green rug on the floor. There is a small, low wooden table in the center. A single window on the back wall shows a sunny spring garden outside. A small, simple toy shelf with a few colorful blocks is on the right wall. Warm, bright light from the window. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Päikseline park
locations.description: Bright and sunny spring park with lush green grass, a few young trees with fresh green leaves. Clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Some colorful spring flowers (small and scattered) are visible in the grass. A simple wooden park bench is in the distance. Gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Mari and Juku are sitting on the green rug in their play corner, facing each other. Mari is holding a small, soft, blue toy bird in her hands. Juku is looking at the toy bird with a friendly smile. The room has light blue walls, a soft green rug, a low wooden table, a simple toy shelf, and a window showing a sunny spring garden. Warm, bright light from the window. Cartoon style.

Mari is gently holding the small blue toy bird, looking a little thoughtful. Juku is looking at the toy bird with concern, then looks at Mari with an idea forming. They are sitting on the green rug in their play corner. The room has light blue walls, a soft green rug, a low wooden table, a simple toy shelf, and a window showing a sunny spring garden. Warm, bright light from the window. Cartoon style.

Mari and Juku are standing in the bright and sunny spring park. Mari is pointing excitedly towards some bushes on the left side of the scene. Juku is smiling and looking in the same direction. They are standing on lush green grass with small spring flowers around them. Clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

Mari and Juku are kneeling on the lush green grass in the sunny park. Mari is carefully picking up a small, thin twig from the ground. Juku is looking under a small bush on the right side of the scene, searching for more twigs. Small spring flowers are scattered in the grass. Clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

Mari and Juku are still kneeling on the lush green grass in the sunny park. Mari is gently collecting soft, fresh green leaves and placing them in a small pile on the grass. Juku is holding a few green leaves in his hand, looking at them carefully. Small spring flowers are scattered in the grass. Clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

Mari and Juku are sitting on the lush green grass in the sunny park. They have a small pile of twigs and leaves between them. Mari is carefully intertwining a thin twig with some leaves, starting to form a round nest shape with her hands. Juku is watching intently, ready to help, holding a few twigs. Small spring flowers are scattered in the grass. Clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

Mari and Juku are focused on building the nest. Mari is still weaving twigs and leaves together, holding a partially formed nest in her hands. Juku is handing her a small, soft leaf to add to the nest. They are sitting on the lush green grass in the sunny park, surrounded by their gathered materials. Small spring flowers are scattered in the grass. Clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

Mari and Juku are proudly holding up a small, beautifully woven nest made of twigs and leaves. They are smiling happily and looking at the finished nest. The nest is complete and looks cozy. They are sitting on the lush green grass in the sunny park. Small spring flowers are scattered in the grass. Clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

Mari and Juku are back in their play corner. Mari is gently placing the small blue toy bird into the newly built nest, which is now sitting on the small wooden table. Juku is looking at the bird in the nest with a warm smile. The room has light blue walls, a soft green rug, a low wooden table, a simple toy shelf, and a window showing a sunny spring garden. Warm, bright light from the window. Cartoon style.

Mari and Juku are standing next to the small wooden table in their play corner, both smiling broadly and looking at the nest. The small blue toy bird is resting comfortably in its new nest on the table. They are looking at the nest and the bird with joy. The room has light blue walls, a soft green rug, a low wooden table, a simple toy shelf, and a window showing a sunny spring garden. Warm, bright light from the window. Cartoon style.
